biography:
== Biography ==
Jeremiah O'Donnell was born in Ireland about August 1835, the son of Joseph and Mary O'Donnell.<ref name="jerdeath">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database with images, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:NWMQ-N7N : accessed 18 November 2026), Jeremiah O'Donnell, died 17 Nov 1882, Boston, entry 7907; widowed, 47 years 3 months 7 days, tailor, born Ireland; parents Joseph and Mary.</ref> He was a tailor.

In 1861 he was living in the parish of St Benet in the City of London with his wife Eliza, also born in Ireland, and their son James W., aged 1.<ref name="cen1861">"1861 England Census", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/8767/records/5480522 : accessed 18 November 2026), St Benet, City of London, ED 9, schedule 52; TNA RG 9/227, folio 76, p. 9. Jeremiah O'Donnell (indexed "Samuel"), head, 26, tailor, born Ireland; Eliza, wife, 25, born Ireland; James W., son, 1, born St Benet, London.</ref> By 1868 the family had moved to Massachusetts. In 1870 they lived in Cambridge, with sons James W. and Michael J. (both born in England) and Jerome J.<ref name="cen1870">"1870 United States Federal Census", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/7163/records/26847081 : accessed 18 November 2026), Cambridge Ward 4, Middlesex, Massachusetts, dwelling 82; NARA M593 roll 624, p. 591A. Jeremiah O'Donnell 35, Eliza 28, James W. 10 (born England), Michael J. 8 (born England), Jerome J. 2.</ref> In 1880 Jeremiah was a widower at 8 Davis Street, Cambridge, with children James, Michael, Joseph, Julia, Francis and Lizzie.<ref name="cen1880">"1880 United States Federal Census", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/6742/records/15361280 : accessed 18 November 2026), 8 Davis St, Cambridge, Middlesex, Massachusetts, ED 431, p. 309A. Jeremiah O'Donnell, 45, widower, tailor, born Ireland; children James 19, Michael 18, Joseph 12, Julia 9, Francis 7, Lizzie 5.</ref> His name was given as Jerome on his son James's 1882 marriage record.<ref name="marr1882">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database with images, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:NW5J-1BC : accessed 18 November 2026), James W. O'Donnell and Susan T. Mullen, married 21 Sep 1882, Boston, entry 2849. Groom 23, brass finisher, born England, parents Jerome and Elizabeth; bride 21, born Cambridge, parents James and Catharine.</ref>

Jeremiah died in Boston on 17 November 1882, aged 47, of pneumonia.<ref name="jerdeath" />

=== Research Notes ===
* Probably married at St Martin in the Fields, London, in late 1856 (FreeBMD vol. 1a p. 558; the bride on that page is indexed as Elizabeth Delay/Le Lay, possibly a misreading of O'Hea). Not yet confirmed.
* His Irish home place is not known.
